captive_girl_10.m: Excuse me, young one! Wait! Thank you for sparing me earlier. You've shown true compassion.
r: What ... do I know you? You're just a young girl?

captive_girl_20.m: Yes, I was under a spell that made me appear as the witch. She wanted to test your heart. I'm glad you proved kind.
r: Thank you, but you don't look well.

captive_girl_30.m: I am not well. Which is why I have not run far from this awful place and this awful witch.
r: What's wrong? Why can't you leave?
What happened to you here? How did you get here?

captive_girl_31.m: Thank you again, my savior! I will go now.

captive_girl_35.m: I need nutrients! You see, I've been held down in that basement of that horrific house for what feels like a year.

captive_girl_35a.m: I am too sick to talk about this right now.

captive_girl_40.m: All the witch ever gave me is something called 'Tonic of Blood'. At first, I refused to drink it, but soon I became desperate and I drank it.
r: I've had one or two of those. They are not that bad.
Are those things even good for you?

captive_girl_45.m: Yes, maybe in moderation. But after a few dozen, they do something to your body as I can no longer consume anything but them.

captive_girl_50.m: I really need to get my hands on a lot of those 'Tonic of Blood' potions. Can you help me? I need a lot.
r: Well, I have twenty-five of those for you.
Well, I have twenty of those for you.
Well, I have ten of those for you.
Well, I have five of those for you and I'm not sure where I got them. Do you know where I can get some?
Well, I only have one of those for you and I don't remember where I got it. Do you know where I can get some more?
I'm sorry, but I don't have any of those.

captive_girl_54.m: Only twenty? I was really hoping for twenty-five.
r: Whatever! Fine. I will go get you five more.
I know that you "asked" for twenty-five, but I have twenty and they are hard to get. Please take these.

captive_girl_55.m: Well, I am not exactly sure about that as the witch would make it. Damn! I hate that smell. Damn! I love that taste however.
r: Can you help me out a little bit? Do you know anything about them?

captive_girl_56.m: Can you get me twenty-five of them?

captive_girl_65.m: Ah, YES. I remember her saying that an "undead" friend of her's east of here taught her how to make them.
r: OK. Stay here. I will be back with more of them.

captive_girl_70.m: OK. I won't make you go back just for five more when you've already brought me twenty.

captive_girl_71.m: WOW! You actually managed to find twenty-five! I am so grateful.

captive_girl_75.m: Before you go, I was able to steal this from the witch as I was escaping. I want you to have it. I need to go now.

captive_girl_76.m: I need to go now. Thanks a lot.

wicked_witch.10: Bela, the Fallhaven tavern keeper heard from a customer about a possible kidnapping of a girl. I should ask around town if anyone knows more.
wicked_witch.20: The "busy farmer", in the southeastern part of Fallhaven knows something about the witch.
wicked_witch.30: The "busy farmer" and his best friend, Addie, were kept captive by the witch a very long time ago when they were just kids. He never saw Addie again.
wicked_witch.40: The "busy farmer" told me that the witch's house is just south of Fallhaven. Covered in beautiful flowers.
wicked_witch.50: After meeting Bonicksa, the wicked witch, I decided to let her live and she did likewise, but not before leaving me with a very cryptic response. Saying I was "confident in my path" and that "we shall see". I wonder what that meant?
wicked_witch.60: I killed what I thought was Bonicksa, but I quickly realized that I killed an innocent girl.
wicked_witch.65: I "killed" Bonicksa again, only for her to reappear.
wicked_witch.70: Bonicksa lives and could not be defeated. But I learned a huge life lesson.
wicked_witch.80: I discovered a young girl named Emmeline just behind the 'wicked witch's' house. The witch was really Emmeline under a spell from Bonicksa.
wicked_witch.85: Emmeline asked me to get her "a lot" of those "Tonics of Blood".
wicked_witch.90: Emmeline told me to head east of the witch's house to find the undead that know about the 'Tonic of Blood'.
wicked_witch.95: I gave Emmeline 25 of the "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.
wicked_witch.96: I gave Emmeline 20 of the 25 "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.
